plate_comment: TPU-A channel 0 interrupt handler (tpu_a_channel_interrupt_handler_table; no direct caller): runs the crank sync state machine cam_crank_sync_state.crank_sync_state from the channel's status - 0 no sync -> 2 start sync (start_sync_count up to crank_sync_attempt_limit) -> 3 preliminary sync (crank_preliminary_sync_count, then enough firing detections) -> 4 in sync (crank_have_sync_time_ticks, speed limp home ends); 1 = crank sync lost, back to 4 through the cam when the cam is in sync with enough good cam pulses, else to 3. It also counts crank_sync_error_count and, while the cam is not in sync above engine_position_sensor_error_detection_minimum_engine_speed, cam_sync_error_count (was mpc555_updateEngineRunState) | earlier note: TPU-A channel 0 interrupt handler - reached via tpu_a_channel_interrupt_handler_table (mpc555_tpuAInterruptDispatcher 0x55de4) - no direct caller in the decompile - runs the crank run-state machine engine_crank_state_t.run_state 0-4 from tpu_a_ch0_param0

Crank sync lost (from mpc555_updateCrankSyncState): crank_sync_state = 1; with the cam in sync (cam_sync_state 4) and speed limp home not active, enters speed limp home (cm848_enterSpeedLimpHome) and re-runs engine_injectionTiming_crankSyncDispatch (was cm848_setEngineRunState1) | earlier note: Run state transition handler: sets engine_crank_state.run_state to 1 and, when speed limp home is not active and crank_state is 4, calls cm848_enterSpeedLimpHome (backup speed input) and re-runs engine_injectionTiming_crankSyncDispatch.

Cam sync lost (from mpc555_handleCamSignalInterrupt): cam_sync_state = 1; when speed limp home is active it ends it (cm848_exitSpeedLimpHome) and re-runs engine_injectionTiming_crankSyncDispatch (was cm848_setEngineCrankState1) | earlier note: Crank state transition handler: sets engine_crank_state.crank_state to 1 and, when engine_speed_limp_home_active_flag is 1 (speed limp home), calls cm848_exitSpeedLimpHome and re-runs engine_injectionTiming_crankSyncDispatch.

crank_sync_state = 3 (preliminary sync) from start sync (mpc555_updateCrankSyncState) and from hpcr_processEngineSyncPulses: snapshots average_pulse_period, restarts crank_preliminary_sync_count from crank_preliminary_sync_evaluation_count, ends speed limp home when it is active, re-runs engine_injectionTiming_crankSyncDispatch and latches crank_preliminary_sync_time_ticks the first time (was cm848_engineRunState3HandlerWithTimebaseCapture) | earlier note: Crank run state 3 transition handler: the same steps as cm848_engineRunState3Handler (snapshot average_pulse_period into crank_period_prev_snapshot, restart crank_preliminary_sync_count from its calibration, run_state = 3, leave speed limp home if it is active, re-run engine_injectionTiming_crankSyncDispatch) and additionally latches crank_preliminary_sync_time_ticks = TBLr - first_speed_interrupt_time_ticks the first time it is 0. No protection logic. (was cm848_protectionOverrideEvaluator)

crank_sync_state = 3 again after crank sync was lost with no usable cam (mpc555_updateCrankSyncState in state 1): cm848_enterCrankPreliminarySync without the time latch (was cm848_engineRunState3Handler) | earlier note: Run state 3 transition handler: snapshots average_pulse_period into crank_period_prev_snapshot, restarts crank_preliminary_sync_count from its calibration, sets run_state to 3, leaves speed limp home if it is active and re-runs engine_injectionTiming_crankSyncDispatch.
The cam signal handler's crank_sync_state = 3: snapshots average_pulse_period and restarts crank_preliminary_sync_count; no speed limp home change, no dispatch (was cm848_setEngineRunState3)

crank_sync_state = 4 (in sync) when crank sync lost recovers through the cam (mpc555_updateCrankSyncState): ends speed limp home, re-runs engine_injectionTiming_crankSyncDispatch and latches crank_have_sync_time_ticks the first time (was cm848_engineRunState4Handler)
The cam signal handler's crank_sync_state = 4: the same body as cm848_enterCrankInSync (was cm848_engineRunState4Handler2)

The cam signal handler's other crank_sync_state = 4: ends speed limp home and re-runs engine_injectionTiming_crankSyncDispatch only when speed limp home is active; latches crank_have_sync_time_ticks the first time (was cm848_engineRunState4Conditional) | earlier note: Run state 4 transition handler: sets run_state to 4, leaves speed limp home (and re-runs engine_injectionTiming_crankSyncDispatch) only if it is active, and latches crank_have_sync_time_ticks = TBLr - first_speed_interrupt_time_ticks the first time it is 0. cm848_engineRunState4Handler and ...Handler2 do the same but leave speed limp home unconditionally.
